rationale.conceptual: The paper applies known techniques (Gaussian coarse-graining, coordination number, Shannon entropy) to a large dataset of GBs; however, the method involves several non-trivial steps (computing φ₂ via local Voronoi volume, solving for φ₁, extracting GB-plane averages, computing excess entropies) that require careful implementation beyond a simple textbook exercise.
rationale.execution: The task involves generating and relaxing 408 distinct bicrystal configurations with LAMMPS, then post-processing to compute multiple scalar properties and entropies. This multi-stage pipeline requires orchestrating external tools (LAMMPS, Atomsk), managing many simulation runs, and assembling results into a CSV, with several fragile handoffs.
